name: B10-0362/2026 (PPE) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to the fighting in El-Obeid, Sudan, where over 500,000 civilians are under siege and facing drone attacks. It condemns war crimes, including killings, rape and deliberate starvation, and urges all sides and outside countries to stop the violence and arms supplies. It asks the European Union to sanction those responsible, extend a United Nations arms embargo across Sudan, and give more aid, including to local emergency groups.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks the European Union to sanction those behind the El-Obeid attacks and send more aid.
- **Who it affects:** Civilians in El-Obeid and Sudan, the warring sides, and outside countries supplying arms.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and the warring parties; sanctions and aid depend on them.
